PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fire Safety.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fire Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fire Safety.

2. When learning Cutting Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

6. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.

7. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.

8. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

9. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

10. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.

11. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.

12. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Visual Programming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
